title: Save-On-Foods Style Lemon Herb Fish Kebobs & Grilled Veg
originalTitle: Save on fish kebobs and veg
ingredients: 1.5 lbs firm fish fillets (salmon, steelhead, cod, or halibut), cut into 1.5-inch cubes
1 red bell pepper & 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1.5-inch squares
1 tbsp fresh dill + 1 tsp dried oregano, salt & black pepper
instructions: Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, minced garlic, dill, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss cubed fish and vegetables in the lemon-herb marinade for 15–20 minutes.
Thread fish cubes alternating with bell peppers, red onion, zucchini, and mushrooms onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat (400°F) or broil for 8–10 minutes, turning once, until the fish is flaky and vegetables are lightly charred.
